narrative.details:
Nothing my tavern patrons enjoy more than some Beer Basted Boar Ribs!  Only problem is, the local trapper who used to bring me supplies enlisted in the King's Army to help with the war on the Alliance front.

Maybe you can help me out?  If you bring me six crag boar ribs and a Rhapsody Malt from the tavern here, I'll give you the family recipe for my famous Beer Basted Boar Ribs, not to mention a free sample!  The secret's in the Malt!
narrative.objectives: Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos wants 6 Crag Boar Ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt.
narrative.offerRewardText:
The Malt is brewed, the Boars are dead

And before all is done and anything said

We will have to fight for first dibs

On these savory Beer Basted Boar Ribs!
narrative.requestItemsText: I'm going to need six crag boar ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt, adventurer.
